gms._about: GMs for a 2002 start. Parody names only. 'starting' = the 2002-03 front offices (team = franchise id), 'arrivals' = GMs whose first job came later; they join the GM market from available_from_year and are hired only when a seat opens. Ages are in 2002. Skills 50-82 (CONFIG.FRONT_OFFICE.SKILL_START_MIN/MAX). Traits: codes from CONFIG.FRONT_OFFICE.TRAITS. Editable: change names, traits, skills or years freely.
